percentile_method: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p, per-frame sum of repeated identical segment paths
limits: CPU segment is render-thread wall interval, not exclusive CPU self time
GPU segment is queue elapsed time including dependencies/feed gaps
Inclusive group totals overlap segments; never add them
Last marker excludes later unmarked submit/present work
Source draw mapping uses original CPU envelope contained in pre/post; token is not pose identity
Snapshot PBR diagnostic has no full AI or High parity
